name: attachment-nudge
title: Attachment Nudge
description: Spots attachment phrases in English, Hindi and Hinglish ("PFA", "attach kar diya"), ignoring quoted replies, negations, future mentions and shared cloud links, and asks inline to Attach or Send anyway.

meta.summary: Notices "see attached" in a message with nothing attached and asks inline whether to attach a file or send anyway.
catches: Attachment phrases ("see attached", "PFA", "attach kar diya") with no file attached
Skips quoted reply lines, negated or future mentions and messages with a Drive, Dropbox or OneDrive link
limits: Phrase matching only; other wordings and other languages are missed
It cannot check that the attached file is the right one
a11y: Textarea is labelled (aria-label) and Ctrl/Cmd+Enter sends, exposed via aria-keyshortcuts
The prompt is a role="group" labelled by its text; focus moves to Attach when it appears and Escape returns to the textarea
Remove buttons on attachments have aria-labels naming the file
A polite live region announces changes
